Class
Description
AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
Repo that keeps the entities in memory and in a text file (one entity per line) Template method: the writing and reading happen here, once, the subclasses only say how a line becomes an entity and the other way around The file is loaded when the repo is created, and updated at every crud command of the repo
Consola
the console interface, menu, options, prints; the errors are caught here
Entity<ID>
base class for all the entities with an id two entities are equal if they have the same id
InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Repo that keeps the entities in memory, in a hashmap Every key is checked by the validator before it is saved or updated
Main

Repository<ID,E>

RepositoryFactory
Simple Factory for repositories, the only class that knows the repository classes and picks the persistence type Both repo types are created for the same persistence type
